ORDINANCE XII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XII OF 1984
FEE-CHARGING EMPLOYMENT AGENCIES (REGULATION) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,
1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Fee-Charging Employment Agencies
(Regulation) Act, 1976
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 10th April, 1984]
No. F. 17(1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Fee-Charging Employment Agencies (Regulation) (Amendment) Ordi nance, 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Fee-Charging Employment Agencies Regulation Amendment Ordinance 1984
sections.description:
Amendment of section 5, Act LXXVII of 1976

ORDINANCE XII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XII OF 1984
FEE-CHARGING EMPLOYMENT AGENCIES (REGULATION) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,
1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Fee-Charging Employment Agencies
(Regulation) Act, 1976
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 10th April, 1984]
No. F. 17(1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 5, Act LXXVII of 1976.--In the Fee-Charging
Employment Agencies (Regulation) Act, 1976 (LXXVII of 1976), in section 5, after
subsection (4), the following new subsections shall be added, namely :-
"(5) Any
person aggrieved by an order under subsection (4) may, within sixty days of the
date of the order, appeal to the Federal Government, and the Federal Government
may pass such order thereon as it may deem fit.
(6) No order
affecting any person under subsection (4) or subsection (5) be passed without
giving such person a reasonable opportunity of being heard,"
